message.content: what makes the tile cache mark a tile stale?

content.text: Two independent conditions. A tile is stale if its generation counter differs from the cache generation, which happens after any style reload, or if it has been held longer than the freshness window. The generation check fires first, so a style reload invalidates every tile at once regardless of age.

message.content: ok. make the evictor respect the same staleness window then

content.text: The evictor only looks at age, so a reloaded tile survives eviction. Routing it through the same predicate.
